candidates.name: mGameAreaManager
candidates.note: laid out sequentially from the previous field/base; verify

resolution.verdict: pointer to the game-logic object, stored at CStateManager+0x4E0150
resolution.evidence: NSharedPlayerControls and CPlayerMP1 functions (UpdateFreeLookState_Gyro 0xc6cb30, ComputeFreeLook 0xc71638) load an 8-byte value from CStateManager+0x4E0150, add 48 and dereference again, add 128 and dereference to reach the player actor. So the slot holds a pointer, not an inline CStateManagerGameLogicMP1.
resolution.consequence: The practice mod's GameLogic() returns the address of that slot (GetField gives address-of); one extra dereference is needed. In the Rando header the field is named mStateManagerGameLogic and its sequential offset lands on 0x4E0150 only when the leading gap is read as starting at offset 0 (its name 'gapA' is misleading). Two command-frame objects sit inline at CStateManager+0x4E01C0 and +0x4E0320.
resolution.confidence: high for the pointer at 0x4E0150, medium for the neighbouring slots (CGameAreaManager* at 0x4E0140 is the header's claim, not verified)
